production.direction_en: A herald’s pennant appears through ravine mist. Marek recognizes the empty crest socket on Mahmut’s armor.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch5_bridge — fog, wind in chains; a solo horn for Marek's pennant | post: bgm_mahmut_theme (Marek recognizes the crest)

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: That socket used to carry a crown. The road has not forgotten.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: The road remembers a version of me that no longer exists.

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: Good. Then it can remember this one too.
